content.title: Task Management REST API
content.summary: A Spring Boot REST API for managing tasks with CRUD operations and input validation.

functionalRequirements.title: Create task
functionalRequirements.description: Clients can create a task with a title, optional description and status.

functionalRequirements.title: Read tasks
functionalRequirements.description: Clients can fetch a single task by id and list all tasks.

functionalRequirements.title: Update task
functionalRequirements.description: Clients can update the title, description and status of an existing task.

functionalRequirements.title: Delete task
functionalRequirements.description: Clients can delete an existing task.

functionalRequirements.title: Validate input
functionalRequirements.description: Invalid task payloads are rejected with HTTP 400.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Java 21 / Spring Boot
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Implemented with Java 21 and Spring Boot, built with Maven.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Testability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: All endpoints are covered by automated JUnit 5 tests.

acceptanceCriteria.description: POST /api/tasks with a valid body returns 201, a Location header and the created task.
GET /api/tasks/{id} returns the task and GET /api/tasks lists created tasks.
PUT /api/tasks/{id} updates the task and returns it.
DELETE /api/tasks/{id} returns 204 and the task is no longer retrievable.
A blank or longer than 120 characters title is rejected with 400.
Unknown ids return 404 for get and delete.

openQuestions: Is persistence to a database required?
Are due dates or assignees needed?
